&= \text{₹ }12\,(4 \times 18000 - 76000) = \text{₹ }48{,}000\ \text{(A)}
\end{aligned}
$$

2. Direct Labour Cost Variance:
Direct Labour Rate Variance

$$

Variable Overhead Expenditure Variance

$$

Variable Overhead Efficiency variance

$$

&= \text{₹ }2\,(5 \times 18{,}000 - 84{,}000) = \text{₹ }12{,}000\ \text{(F)}
\end{aligned}
$$

Fixed Overhead Expenditure variance

$$
\begin{aligned}
&= \text{Budgeted Fixed overhead} - \text{Actual Fixed Overhead} \\
&= 20{,}000 \times \text{₹ }50 - \text{₹ }10{,}30{,}000 = \text{₹ }30{,}000\ \text{(A)}
